name: Domain
description: Core business concepts and rules, independent of any technical delivery mechanism.

name: Entity
description: A domain object defined by identity that persists across state changes.

name: Value Object
description: A domain object defined by its attribute values rather than identity.

name: Domain Service
description: Domain logic that doesn't naturally belong to a single entity or value object.

name: Domain Event
description: A record of something meaningful that happened in the domain.

name: Application
description: Orchestration of domain logic to fulfill a specific use case.

name: Use Case
description: A single application-level operation invoked from outside the domain.

name: Application Service
description: A type that orchestrates domain objects to carry out a use case.

name: Inbound Port
description: An interface through which the outside world drives the application.

name: Outbound Port
description: An interface through which the application reaches an external system.

name: Driving Adapter
description: An adapter that invokes the application through an inbound port.

name: Driven Adapter
description: An adapter that implements an outbound port to reach an external system.

name: Inbound Adapter
description: An adapter on the inbound side of the application boundary.

name: Outbound Adapter
description: An adapter on the outbound side of the application boundary.
